statement: Pinned hid-nintendo parses full input reports using timer, battery/connection byte, three button bytes, packed 12-bit sticks (three bytes per stick), vibrator echo, and either subcommand reply or three six-axis IMU samples in report 0x30.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Consumer struct/parser layout; units, orientation, actual packet cadence and validity require independent calibration and reference runs.
